headline: Fierce Fronts Flare at Fishermans Row Lykos Isle
war_summary: Since the 15:11 edition the western fringe has sharpened dramatically. Fishermans Row logged ten ownership changes in the last two hours, raising its day‑total to thirty‑eight flips, the latest at 17:25 Z. Lykos Isle, quiet in the earlier report, now records five captures in two hours and fourteen in twenty‑four, most recent at 17:43 Z. Dead Lands added two flips in the past two hours (five total today), and Weathered Expanse recorded two more (nine total), both with latest events at 17:10 Z. Stlican Shelf saw a single new flip at 16:10 Z, bringing its day count to eight. Farranac Coast has had no new flips since 04:10 Z but retains eleven changes in the past day. Casualty streams are accelerating on several fronts — Loch Mor, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, Kings Cage, Stlican Shelf and Farranac Coast show rising losses for both factions — while Clahstra and Callahans Passage are cooling. The strategic picture still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
